name: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships (UK)
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (FCDO)

rules.quote: Be a citizen of or have been granted refugee status by an eligible Commonwealth country, or be a British Protected Person.

rules.value: permanently resident in eligible Commonwealth country
rules.quote: Be permanently resident in an eligible Commonwealth country.
hold a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) honours standard, or a lower second-class degree and a relevant postgraduate qualification
Be unable to afford to study in the UK without this scholarship.
There is no age limit for CSC applications.
The CSC funds one-year taught Master’s programmes only and does not fund MBA degrees.

rules.value: apply via national nominating agency, not directly
rules.quote: The CSC does not accept direct applications for these scholarships.

amount.text: Full tuition, airfare, stipend GBP 1,712/month (GBP 2,000 London), study travel grant
amount.quote: Stipend (living allowance) at the rate of £1,712 per month, or £2,000 per month for those at universities in the London metropolitan area

documents.name: Passport or national ID
documents.quote: a copy of a valid passport (or national ID card) showing a photograph, date of birth, and country of citizenship.

documents.name: Full transcripts
documents.quote: Full transcripts detailing all higher education qualifications

documents.name: Two references
documents.quote: References from at least two individuals, in PDF format

deadline.quote: The closing date for applications was 16:00 BST on Tuesday 20 October.
